_purpose: Quick lookup of what each page/feature does and which files back it — read this before grepping the whole codebase to find 'which thing does what'. Narrative detail and the 'why' behind non-obvious decisions still live in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; this file is the fast index into it. Keep both in sync when adding, renaming, or removing a page or a major feature.
stack: Node/Express + MySQL backend, Vue 3 (CDN, Options API, no build step) frontend — every component file is a plain <script> tag wrapped in an IIFE (see any component's header comment for why).

contentPages._note: Pages rendered generically from src/js/db.js's DB[] array (paragraph/list/table content blocks) — no dedicated component or server route beyond the generic page renderer in index.html. Some embed one of calculators.js's 9 biometric calculator widgets inline (check the page's `content` array in db.js for a `calculator` block type if a specific formula/tool is needed).

features.title: Daily Mission Control
features.component: src/js/components/... (dashboard rendered in index.html's main v-else-if chain, see app.js's `dashboard` data)
features.dataModel: dashboards — one JSON blob per profile (GET/PUT only)
features.description: Daily checklist-style overview (calories/protein/water/sleep targets vs actuals). Single JSON blob, not normalized rows.

features.title: Exercise Journal & Analytics
features.dataModel: workout_logs (date, type, duration, distance, weight, reps, notes)
features.description: Manual workout log (run/cycle/lift sessions) — CRUD list, feeds AI Analyzer's 'Workout log entries' section alongside Daily Tracker activities.

features.title: Week Builder
lib: src/server/lib/exercises.js (EXERCISE_TEMPLATES, 224 entries — mode: interval|steady|strength|mobility + structured timer)
features.dataModel: training_weeks (profile_id + week_start_date, unique) / training_blocks (day_of_week, block_type, title, duration_min, details JSON: exerciseId | subBlocks[])
features.description: Drag-and-drop (SortableJS) weekly training planner. Day/Week/Month views. Blocks can be compound (details.subBlocks — multiple exercises per session) with an inline timer widget. Mobile: '📍 Place' button opens a day+position picker modal instead of drag; palette browsing is a category tile grid + modal below 1024px. 'Start Workout' hands a workoutQueue.js step queue to Sprint Timer. Every BLOCK_TEMPLATES label has a matching EXERCISE_TEMPLATES name by design — see ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Every BLOCK_TEMPLATES label...' note if either file is edited.

features.title: Goal Dashboard
features.description: Milestone/goal CRUD. 'Build Week from this Goal' hands off to Week Builder via $root.pendingAutobuildGoalId, which runs autobuild.js's rules engine (not AI) for that goal's domain (running/trail/calisthenics/cycling/swimming/boxing/general).

features.title: Daily Tracker
features.dataModel: daily_trackers (profile_id + date, unique; legacy strava_url/notes columns, read-only) / tracker_activities (one row per logged activity: name, strava_url, notes, sort_order) / tracker_screenshots (activity_id nullable, app-level reference only, no FK) / tracker_wellness (one row per day, unique on tracker_id: name, description, link, score) / wellness_screenshots (FK to tracker_wellness)
features.description: A day can hold MULTIPLE activities (added 2026-07-28), each with its own name/Strava link/notes/screenshots, added via '+ Add activity' and removed via '− Remove' (native confirm() warning first — destructive, deletes screenshot files too). Pre-existing single-activity data (before this existed) is synthesized as a pseudo-activity (id: 'legacy') and promotes into a real row on first edit — see routes/tracker.js's header comment. Below the activities list sits Wellness Track (added 2026-07-28): a single per-day entry (name, description, optional link, 0-100 score, screenshots) for wearable-summary data like a Samsung Galaxy Watch daily score — upserted on save, never a list, no legacy-promotion behavior. Shows read-only chips of whatever Week Builder planned for the same date (no FK, re-derives week_start_date+day_of_week). Embeds the AI Analyzer panel below.

features.title: AI Analyzer
features.component: src/js/components/aiAnalyzer.js (embedded only inside Daily Tracker — no page id of its own)
features.dataModel: ai_analyses (profile_id, scope, period_start, period_end, summary, raw_response) — cache key is (profile_id, scope, period_start)
features.description: day/week/month vision-model summary over workout_logs + Daily Tracker activities + Food Planner meals + Supplements taken. Per-activity screenshots are grouped with that activity's own name/notes as adjacent content parts (not one flat image pile) so the model can scope down a day activity-by-activity. Strava links are never sent to the model (not fetchable — see openai.js's buildIntro()). Cached per period; 'Regenerate' forces a fresh (quota-metered) call.

features.title: Sprint Timer
features.description: Giant-UI interval timer for run/cycling/swimming, warmup -> (work<->rest)xrounds -> cooldown, or a plain 'steady' continuous phase for non-interval exercises. Opened directly: manual category/preset picker. Opened via Week Builder's '▶ Start': consumes a workoutQueue.js step queue instead (this.queue), skipping the picker — each step's own resolved mode (interval vs steady) drives the phase engine, which is what makes an easy/steady exercise never render as interval rounds. Web Audio beeps + SpeechSynthesis voice cues + Wake Lock; no build step, no asset files.

features.title: Settings
features.description: Password change (bcrypt + shared policy check), usage quota display, language preference (persists users.preferred_language; 'Apply' separately flips the googtrans cookie Google Translate reads + reloads — not auto-applied on login), theme toggle (shared root darkMode state, no new state here).

features.title: Food Planner
features.dataModel: meal_plans (profile_id + week_start_date) / meal_plan_items (day_of_week, meal_slot, food_id, grams — food_id is a string reference into foods.js, not an FK)
features.description: Weekly meal planner, one day shown at a time (day tabs) + a week-overview kcal-vs-target strip. All macro math computed server-side from grams + foods.js on every read.

features.title: Supplements
features.lib: src/server/lib/supplements.js (SUPPLEMENT_TEMPLATES, the same 8 supplements cited in db.js pages 7/8)
features.dataModel: supplement_intakes (profile_id, date, supplement_key) — 'taken' is row presence, not a boolean; PUT replaces the whole day's set (delete-all-then-reinsert)
features.description: Daily supplement checklist, same day-navigation pattern as Daily Tracker.

crossCutting.auth: src/server/routes/auth.js + middleware/auth.js — session-cookie based (MySQL-backed store, not in-memory), requireAuth only proves a session exists; every profile-scoped route re-checks profile.user_id === session.userId.
crossCutting.quotas: src/server/lib/quota.js + usage_events table — durable per-account daily caps on screenshot uploads and AI analyze calls, no bypass for any account.
crossCutting.heroImages: src/server/lib/pexels.js + routes/images.js — per-page heroQuery string in db.js, 24h server cache, graceful null fallback if no PEXELS_API_KEY.
crossCutting.sidebarNav: src/js/db.js's NAV_GROUPS + app.js's navGroups/setPage() — mobile drawer below 1024px is a group-tile grid + modal (activeNavGroupModal), not the desktop's full list; see ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Collapsible sidebar' section.
